title.narrative: Supporting livelihoods and economic recovery through accelerated skills training

description.narrative:
The project aims to restore urgent learning and livelihood opportunities for vulnerable Palestinian youth in Gaza and the West Bank through accelerated, market-relevant technical and vocational skills training. Building on UNESCO’s mandate and its operational presence in Gaza, the project expands access to crisis-responsive skills development by adding one new Temporary Learning Space (TLS) to UNESCO’s existing network of three TLSs currently serving over 10,000 students, and by establishing modular TVET training units in the West Bank.
The project delivers short-cycle, hybrid vocational training across three priority early-recovery vocations identified in post-war labour analyses, combining in-person practical training with digital modules. Activities include equipping the TLS and TVET units, preparing hybrid training materials, training instructors, and implementing accelerated training cohorts for youth aged 15+, with a strong focus on women and vulnerable groups.
By restoring access to skills development and supporting youth transitions into employment and self-employment, the project contributes to early recovery, economic resilience, and community stability.
